#+TITLE: Linker

This hub references a few siblings, intentionally leaving some
files unreferenced so the ``orphans`` integration test has
deterministic targets to surface.

- A regular file: [[file:ref.org][ref]]
- A directory link (covers only the dir itself by default):
  [[file:ref-folder/][ref-folder]]
- The ``index.org`` of a folder (covers only ``index.org`` itself):
  [[file:ref-folder/index.org][folder index]]
- A nested file in a separate subtree:
  [[file:sub/visited.org][visited]]
- Self-link so this hub isn't itself reported as orphan:
  [[file:linker.org][self]]

* Metadata references
:PROPERTIES:
:PREDECESSOR: [[file:metadata-only.org][metadata only]]
:END:
:LOGBOOK:
- Note taken on [2026-08-17 Mon] see [[file:metadata-only.org][again]]
:END:

The two links above are metadata, not body text. ``orphans``
counts body links only, so ``metadata-only.org`` must still be
reported as an orphan.
